newsitem.title: UK: Dollar helps Kvaerner first-half profits.
newsitem.headline: Dollar helps Kvaerner first-half profits.

text.p: Positive currency movements helped Kvaerner ASA 's first-half profits by a total 111 million Norwegian crowns, the Anglo-Norwegian engineering group said.
The strength of the dollar was a major boost to Kvaerner's shipbuilding operations in Germany and Norway, president and chief executive officer Erik Tonseth said.
The positive dollar impact more than offset the consequences of the pound's strength, Tonseth told journalists.
The pound hurt Kvaerner's UK shipbuilding operations and equipment sales from the British part of the group's metals division, he added.
Kvaerner earlier reported a 19 percent rise in first-half profit to 840 million crowns.
